title: Creative AI Engineer

title: Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description: About Mercor Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. About the Role As a Backend Software Engineer, Infrastructure at Mercor, you'll design and build the core services and platforms that the rest of engineering builds on. title: Base Labs Research Scientist - RL Environments
description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F , led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products. ABOUT BASE LABS Base Labs is Baseten’s research lab, working to advance and democratize open-source intelligence. We publish our research, methods, and results so others can inspect, reproduce, and build on them. Baseten’s training and inference infrastructure gives us a place to test ideas at scale, while our work with companies deploying models keeps us close to the problems those models need to solve. THE ROLE Models learn from the environments we give them. If a reward is easier to exploit than a task is to solve, a model can learn the shortcut. If a task measures the wrong capability, a higher score tells us little about progress. Building good environments requires decisions about what to teach, how to measure it, and how to establish whether it transfers. As a Research Scientist at Base Labs specializing in RL environments, you will create open environments and study how models learn from them. You will design tasks and rewards, develop methods for generating and calibrating environments at scale, and run the training experiments needed to understand their effects.
